text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Yes, this agreement provides for liquidated damages. Specifically, if Party A or its subsidiaries fail to pay the Service Fee in full on schedule, they shall pay Party B liquidated damages at a daily interest rate of 0.03% in respect of the outstanding Service Fee. This is stated in excerpt C2: '4.3 Except as otherwise agreed hereunder, if Party A or its subsidiaries fail to pay the Service Fee in full on schedule according to provisions of Article 4.1 and Article 4.2, then Party A or its subsidiaries shall, in addition to the continuance of the payment of Service Fee in full, it shall pay Party B the liquidated damages at a daily interest rate of 0.03% in respect of the outstanding Service Fee.'.","citations": [{"chunk_id": "C2", "quote": "4.3 Except as otherwise agreed hereunder, if Party A or its subsidiaries fail to pay the Service Fee in full on schedule according to provisions of Article 4.1 and Article 4.2, then Party A or its subsidiaries shall, in addition to the continuance of the payment of Service Fee in full, it shall pay Party B the liquidated damages at a daily interest rate of 0.03% in respect of the outstanding Service Fee."}]}
